text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=metering-ingest-window, severity=high, reason=consumer-lag + token-count delta spike. PD: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345 

pagerduty: Incident INC12345 triggered and routed to oncall:emma. Estimated impacted customers: multiple invoice pipelines.

Emma Liu: acked oncall. I'm on it — starting triage.

Raj Patel: Emma can you confirm scope: is this a single consumer group or whole kafka topic? Any backlog numbers?

Emma Liu: initial check: consumer group `metering-ingest-v2` lag jumped from ~0 to ~120k messages over 10m. A few partitions show repeated rebalances. Logs show `consumer.fetch.error` 503 from ingest-api.

Olivia Gonzalez: adding billing-team — if token counts are off for >1h this could block invoices.

Kevin Choi: I'm looking at the consumer pool autoscaler. Metrics show pods at 100% CPU and OOM throttles on 3/6 replicas. Scaling did not kick due to quota.

Emma Liu: commands run: 
```
# check lag
kubectl exec -c consumer meter-ingest-0 -- ./bin/check-lag --group metering-ingest-v2
# tail logs
kubectl logs meter-ingest-0 -c consumer | tail -n 200
```
Found repeated `Error: upstream read timeout` and `KV cache miss` entries.

Raj Patel: hypothesis: upstream ingest-api transient errors + autoscaler quota prevented scale up -> backlog. Mitigation plan: 1) temporarily increase replica quota, 2) restart the 3 OOMing pods, 3) enable queue drain mode for invoices (prevent new invoice generation), 4) monitor token delta.

Emma Liu: doing step 1: requesting quota bump now. @kevin can you approve a temporary 3-replica increase?

Kevin Choi: approved. Pushing patch to HPA: `kubectl apply -f hpa-temp-bump.yaml` (in progress).

support-bot: Quota request approved by infra. HPA patch deployed by kevin.

Emma Liu: scaling to 9 replicas. Rolling restart of flagged pods starting.

pagerduty: Ack recorded by Emma Liu. Escalation not needed at this time.

Olivia Gonzalez: Billing impact: we've flagged customers with open invoices; recommend putting invoice generation on hold until token counts stabilize to avoid incorrect charges. I'll open an invoice hold ticket and communicate to CS.

Emma Liu: Restarted 3 pods, new replicas coming up. Observed consumer lag decreasing from 120k -> 45k over 7m. Throughput stabilized ~800 rps vs 120 rps before.

Raj Patel: good. Can you post a short snippet of the error traces where upstream fails? we need to see if ingest-api needs a fix too.

Emma Liu: paste logs: 
```
WARN 2026-04-10T02:11:06Z consumer: fetch failed: upstream read timeout (504)
ERROR 2026-04-10T02:11:06Z cache: KV fetch failed for key=acct-1234: connection reset
INFO 2026-04-10T02:12:12Z consumer: rebalance triggered: reason=coordinator_change
```
Looks like transient upstream 504s coinciding with rebalance noise.

Kevin Choi: I'm pinging infra on ingest-api. There was a GC spike on an older tier causing slow responses. We pushed a patch to increase heap & bump JVM flags 10m ago. Rollout is at 60%.

Emma Liu: lag now 12k and falling. Token-delta drift metric trending back to baseline.

Billing Team: Received heads-up. We're opening invoice hold: internal ticket BILL-HOLD-892. Will hold invoice closures for affected accounts and draft outbound comms if counts don't reconcile within 2 hours.

support-bot: Noted. Draft message template available: `templates/invoice-hold.md`

Raj Patel: next actions for ops: keep monitoring for 30m, if lag <5k and token delta <1% for 15m, start controlled backfill. If we see repeated OOMs or GC spikes, escalate to infra page.

Emma Liu: setting a watch and will update in 15m. Also scheduling handoff: I'm on-call for another 42m; if unresolved at +30m I'll handoff to Raj.

pagerduty: Reminder: if incident remains unacknowledged by next escalation window, automatic escalation to SRE lead will occur.

Emma Liu: quick note — will run a manual backfill command once token-drift <1%: `./tools/backfill --topic metering-v2 --since 2026-04-10T01:30Z --rate 500`

Kevin Choi: ingest-api rollout hit 100% patched. GC stable, p95 latency back to normal.

Emma Liu: lag <3.2k now, backfill queued but paused until we confirm no more 504s for 10m.

Olivia Gonzalez: fine from billing side, keep invoice hold until we confirm reconciliation. We'll prepare a short customer note in case we need to communicate.

Emma Liu: 15m check-in: system stable, consumer CPU dropping, lag draining. I'm going to unpause backfill at low rate and monitor.

support-bot: Backfill job started by Emma Liu: `job-id=bf-20260410-01` rate=500. ETA ~18m for catch-up.

Raj Patel: thanks. If backfill completes without regressions and token counts reconcile, we'll close incident. Keep billing informed.

Emma Liu: will update with final reconciliation. If anything regresses I'll re-escalate.

Billing Team: acknowledged, holding invoices until final confirmation.

pagerduty: Incident INC12345 status: monitoring. Last update by Emma Liu.

Emma Liu: final update 40m after start: backfill completed, token-delta <0.2% across affected accounts, no further 504s observed for 20m. Rolling HPA quota revert scheduled in 10m. Closing PD incident and posting post-incident notes.

incident-bot: Incident INC12345 has been resolved by Emma Liu. Please file a short postmortem with root cause: transient ingest-api GC spike + HPA quota prevented scale -> backlog -> token-delta risk. Action items: (1) add HPA runbook for emergency bump, (2) enable earlier GC alerts on ingest-api, (3) add invoice-hold automation.

Emma Liu: filing postmortem ticket PM-INA-2026-04-10 now. Thanks all for quick responses. :thumbsup:
